admission.justification: The shared projection, memory-history origin resolver and two public callers must agree across renames, new closure episodes and merges; named public-read regressions catch substitution of a later or arbitrary parent pair.

applicability: Closed-weakness projection through the public knowledge_read weakness view with closed rows included and the record view, when the stored closure has no commit.
conditions: A unique origin is the introducing memory commit for this selected closed block, followed through the record ID’s merge-preserving history.
A derived commit requires a readable final Code-Commit trailer at that origin and an identical full real commit in the selected code repository.
An uncommitted directory closure is pending; an unreadable or ambiguous origin, incomplete ancestry, or unusable committed attribution is unavailable and explained with commitNote.
exclusions: The projection changes only returned data; it does not backfill record or index bytes.
A stored explicit commit is retained unchanged rather than replaced by a later memory pair.
The guarantee does not promise successful attribution when the required history, trailer or code object is unavailable.

evidence: 261112-BUG-L3-W9-worker.md, item17 acceptance block, checks and Closure census; W9-evidence.tar.gz contains the exact red/green test results and executable commands.

statement: For a closure without a stored commit, the reader uses the unique closing memory commit's Code-Commit trailer or explains why attribution is pending or unavailable.
